line.s_jam.text: I am making jam! The recipe says: six apples.

line.s_enough.text: And do you have exactly six?

line.s_fast.text: I'll count, quick as a flash!

line.s_twice.text: Too fast! You counted this apple twice. Look, it grew twice.

line.s_how.text: Then how do I count without a mistake?

line.s_aside.text: By moving them aside! A counted apple goes to the side.

line.s_show.text: I will show you. Point to an apple, I will move it into the row and say the number.

line.s_six.text: Six apples! None was counted twice.

line.s_after_five.text: After five comes six. We count on, one more.

line.s_solved.text: Exactly six, just like the recipe! There will be jam!

line.s_to_garden.text: Let's go to the garden. The jam needs eight carrots too.

line.b_carrots.text: Carrots are lying everywhere. Count them and move them aside one by one.

line.b_seven.text: Seven carrots! After six comes seven.

line.b_one_more.text: Hop! I pulled out one more!

line.b_how_many_now.text: There were seven, one more came. Count on: point to the new carrot.

line.b_pick.text: Point to the digit that tells how many carrots there are now.

line.b_enough.text: Exactly eight, just what the jam needs!

line.b_to_home.text: Let's go home. We have a party today!

line.c_party.text: Nine guests are coming to the party. Is there a cup for each? Let's count.

line.c_knock.text: Knock, knock! One more guest came. I'll bring a cup.

line.c_count_on.text: Count the new cup on. Point to it.

line.c_ten.text: Nine and one more is ten!

line.c_solved.text: Every guest has a cup. Now you can count to ten!

line.wrong_digit.text: That is another digit. Look again.

line.good_digit.text: Yes! That is the digit. Great!

line.p_count.text: Count everything. Point to each thing only once.

line.p_which_digit.text: Point to the digit that tells how many there are.

line.p_group_7.text: Point to the group with seven things.

line.p_group_9.text: Point to the group with nine things.

line.p_wrong_group.text: Count again, each thing only once.

line.a_game.text: Let's play counting in the hallway, just like at home.

line.a_ok.text: All right! We count and move things aside one by one.

line.a_count_but.text: Count the shoes. Point to each one in turn.

line.a_count_skarpetka.text: Now the socks. How many are there?

line.a_count_klocek.text: And now the blocks. Count them all.

line.a_which_digit.text: Point to the digit that tells how many there are.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to count the shoes in the hallway or the stairs with you.

line.d6.text: This is a six. It looks like a snail sticking its feeler up.

line.d7.text: This is a seven. It has a roof and a long, slanted leg.

line.d8.text: This is an eight. It looks like a snowman made of two balls.

line.d9.text: This is a nine. It looks like a balloon on a string.

line.d10.text: This is ten. We write it with two digits: a one and a zero. Zero is a round ring, like an egg.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the apple from Fox. We got it when we counted all the way to ten.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!
